text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: ええ、成果は着実に積み上げられました
choice_data_list_en: Yes, our hard work has steadily built up results.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Can I truly say I ran a race worthy
of the Rose Clan? And yet...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: To have conceded first place is deeply regrettable...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Though I did not realize it myself...
perhaps there was arrogance somewhere in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I must reflect deeply on this...
choice_data_list: しっかり己を省みられているなら大丈夫です
では、確実に1着をとる策を練りましょう
choice_data_list_en: As long as you are reflecting upon yourself properly, you will be fine.
Then, let's devise a plan to secure 1st place without fail.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: ここは前向きに考えましょう
choice_data_list_en: Let's look on the bright side here.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"'It was close; next time, victory will be ours.'
Perhaps thinking of it that way is healthier."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: My thanks for the sound counsel, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
Regretting it now will accomplish nothing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To avoid treading the same path of failure,
perhaps we should formulate a strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us review the race just now without delay.
I would very much like to hear your perspective as well.
